design_rule: Existing publication fields remain the normal-path contract. Replace_* fields are transaction metadata only. A replacement transaction snapshots last-good state before current publish fields may be reset; commit happens only after the new platform object is verified. Cleanup is a separate post-commit phase.
rollback: All planned schema changes are additive. If implementation validation fails, normal selectors remain unaffected because they do not reference Replace_* fields. Created field IDs will be recorded in the postchange evidence; fields can remain inert until a later verified removal path exists. No existing field type/options/value is changed by this schema step.
